title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: SHNs were decoded to wave and Audition 3.0 was used to reassemble the tracks back to 1 long wave.  Audition 3.0 was used to align & synch the SBD & AUD sources.  Audition 3.0 used to adjust the volume for AUDs, matrix/CTR and LFE channels.
source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shn id 89313) MAC > R1 7.5ips 1/4 track > Technics RS-1506 > Grace designs Lunatec V3 (pre only) > Korg MR-1000 > DSD-DFF 1bit 5.64 Mhz > Audio Gate SW > 24/96 WAV + AUD (shn id 19420) MAC (Taped by Steven Martin, modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M) > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD

ai_review.summary: A killer Baltimore show captured in a superb Kevin Tobin matrix mix, delivering a high‑energy second set with Raven Space, The Wheel‑Truckin’‑Stella Blue run and an emotional Brokedown Palace.
ai_review.review: The April 19 1982 Baltimore concert is praised for its incendiary performance – especially the second‑set sequence of The Wheel into Truckin', Stella Blue, Around And Around, Good Lovin' and a heartfelt Brokedown Palace. The Tobin matrix mix (≈60% soundboard, 40% audience) is described as crisp and “sweet,” though Terrapin Station suffers occasional drop‑outs. Overall the show’s energy and song highlights outweigh these minor flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (mostly 5★) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and mix; only isolated technical hiccups on one song keep the score just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Kevin Tobin’s matrix blend (≈60% SBD, 40% AUD) is praised as crisp, balanced and “sweet,” capturing the band’s insanity; minor drop‑outs noted on Terrapin Station.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid but unremarkable; second set flows brilliantly with seamless segues and high‑energy peaks, culminating in a moving encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice on Peggy-O is called immaculate; guitar phrasing described as exquisite with a long, satisfying solo, though one reviewer found his playing on Franklin's Tower choppy.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for an emotional moment after Brokedown Palace – he lingered onstage, arms outstretched, conveying deep connection with the audience.
